original: I'm sorry, Koromon. You're like\nthis because of me...
Taichi, nothing's gonna change if\nyou just wallow in regret.
You have to perk up! For Koromon's\nsake, and for yourself!
We got the Tags and Crests like\nyou told us to, but...
...we couldn't get our Digimon to\nproperly evolve!
You'll find yourselves with the\nCrests in the end, even if you\ndon't want them.
The Tags and Crests are drawn to\neach other, you see.
But...for example, even with the\nCrests and Tags you've obtained...
You'll get more things like the\nGreymon incident if you don't\nraise the Digimon properly.
Yes. If you don't raise them\nproperly, you can't evolve them\ncorrectly.
But how are we supposed to raise\nthem properly?
Chosen Children, when caring for\nyour Digimon, you should...
Gennai! Ugh, that old man's always\nsaying all these confusing things!
I'm not very confident about this.
I've got no confidence, nope, none\nat all. Confidence at 0 percent.
Why is there a luxury liner in the\nmiddle of the desert?!
Numemon! Can you let us rest on\nyour ship? Koromon's feeling weak!
Numemoooon~! We're tired, so\nplease let us rest in this luxury\nliner, pleeeeease~!
It seems there's also a dining\nroom!
It would be wrong to just barge in\nand eat their food!
Well, if we let the food get cold,\nit would be a disservice to the\nperson who made it.
I've got a big catch today, gya!
While we were in the\nshowers...where'd everyone go?
It's rude to just barge in on us\nlike that! Let's go, Piyomon!
Haaahhhh, that took way too long!
The others might be in trouble,\ntoo. Come on, Mimi, let's go look\nfor them!
A dining room! Someone's eaten\nhere, but...
Must have been Taichi and the\nothers.
But it doesn't look like they're\nhere anymore.
They must've been captured. Hurry,\nlet's find them!
Now that you're here anyway, it\nsaves me some time, ga-ya!
I've put the other five Chosen\nChildren out to be sun-dried,\nga-ya!
Just a bit and I'll have 'em\ncooked nice and dry, ga-ya!
I'll be doing the same to you,\ntoo! Cocka-ka-ka-ka-ka!
We won't let you get away with\nthis!
Taichi! Everyone! I'm so glad\nyou're safe!
Yeah, the Numemon suddenly ran\naway. W-what's that?!
Gennai said that the Tags and\nCrests are drawn to one another.
I didn't even want this. Am I even\nable to raise Palmon properly?
Ah, looks like we can go into this\nroom.
Let's check out the dining room\nfirst!
I can't open this door, it's huge.
It's locked, huh? Let's go find\nthe key!
Maybe this opens that big door!
Ready? I'll go in first, once we\nget the door open.
I'm not letting you face danger by\nyourself!
Thanks, Mimi! Okay, I'm going in!
This is a bit too convenient. It\nreminds me of when we fell into\nDevimon's trap, in that mansion.
We gotta be careful around Numemon.
Yeah, that's a good idea. I'll\ntalk to the others about it, too.
Mimi, you shouldn't have been so\nforward to those Numemon.
But they let us on the ship.
We're safe if we're together, Sora!
They must be plotting something.\nIt's strange for Numemon to be\nliving in a luxury liner.
Yeah, let's stick together as best\nas we can.
I hope this isn't one of Etemon's\ntraps, but...
If we don't figure out what Gennai\nmeant about raising them\nproperly...
Yes, I was just thinking about the\nfuture, since we don't know enough\nabout the Crests.
No, we can't possibly fight\nwithout the Crests. We have to\nlearn to utilize them properly.
But I don't want Palmon to end up\nevolving like Agumon!
I see what you mean, but...
No, Taichi's been working at this\nmuch harder than I have.
Really? I think you've been\nspending a lot of time thinking\nabout this, Koushirou.
You were amazing back there, Mimi!\nI heard what you said to the\nNumemon!
You can't beat my natural charm!
I doubt you could do it, Takeru.
Yuck. I don't want to be *that*\nkind of princess...
Hmph! Even I could do that, if\nit's just a Numemon henchman!
You're so cute when you get\nirritated!
There are a lot of different\nNumemon, huh.
I wanna take a shower soon!
I'll talk with everyone a bit more.
